product_launches.description: NewMe has launched and is operating its quick-delivery arm NewMe Zip, a hyperlocal inventory-based 60-minute fashion service currently active in Bengaluru and parts of Delhi, with plans to scale threefold as the overall business doubles.

press_references.value: Fast fashion brand Newme launches 60-minute delivery service in Bengaluru

product_launches.description: Newme, an omnichannel fast fashion brand, has launched its 60-minute delivery service, Newme Zip, in Bengaluru, expanding from its earlier 90-minute delivery pilot in Delhi. The service offers over 1,500 styles and leverages a network of dark stores across the city, with plans to scale based on demand.

overview_description.description: Newme is a real-time fashion e-commerce platform that offers various trendy clothes. The company presently distributes its clothing brand through both online and offline avenues. Newme embraces diversity and individuality, empowering Generation Z to articulate their unique selves through affordable and accessible latest fashion trends.

about_short_description.short_description: Newme is a Gen Z-focused fashion startup that offers diverse women's fashion trends.

product.name: Women’s Fashion Apparel
product.description: A range of women’s clothing including tops, T-shirts, dresses, bottoms, jumpsuits, bodysuits, co-ords, denim, officewear, and seasonal clothing.

product.name: Denim Collection
product.description: Women’s denim clothing including wide-leg, straight-fit, bootcut, cargo, and relaxed jeans, along with denim skirts, shorts, tops, and bralettes.

product.name: Women’s Occasion and Casual Dresses
product.description: Women’s dresses in mini, midi, maxi, bodycon, fit-and-flare, wrap, asymmetric, and other silhouettes for casual, vacation, party, and evening use.

product.name: Co-ord and Matching Sets
product.description: Coordinated women’s outfits pairing matching tops with trousers, skirts, shorts, skorts, or other bottoms for casual, lounge, work, and occasion wear.

product.name: Women’s Intimates and Lingerie
product.description: Women’s intimate apparel including bras, bralettes, panties, slip dresses, baby dolls, matching sets, and seamless shorties.

product.name: Women’s Athleisure and Winterwear
product.description: Women’s casual activewear and cold-weather clothing including sports tops, sports bras, track pants, sport sets, sweaters, hoodies, sweatshirts, jackets, coats, and cardigans.
